routes._comment: Racemic (untagged) oral IR profile at priority 1, the same fix methylphenidate already carries. The resolved community profile spliced drug.community's onset/peak/offset — a source whose onset already absorbs the come-up, so it publishes no comeup row — with psychonautwiki's comeup 30-135, double-counting ~82 min. The cumulated boundaries came to 562 min (9 h 22 m) while the card's own trio printed the same profile's total as '4-8 h': one screen, two answers. That is the 'Adderall IR graph doesn't seem right' report. Phases below sum to ~325 min against a 240-420 min total, so the curve and the stated total agree. Doses are the recreational ladder the majority of upstream sources already publish for racemic oral amphetamine; they must be present because a route with no `doses` still emits an (empty) dose row that would classify every dose as sub-threshold.

combinations.name: MAOIs
combinations.description: Amphetamine floods norepinephrine and dopamine; an MAOI removes the main way to clear them. Blood pressure can spike into a crisis. Do not combine.

combinations.name: Alcohol
combinations.description: The stimulant hides how drunk and how tired you are, so both get redosed too far. Heart strain adds up even when you can't feel it.

combinations.name: Other stimulants
combinations.description: Cocaine, MDMA, heavy caffeine — heart rate and blood pressure add together. Stacking raises the strain faster than the effect.

combinations.name: SSRIs
combinations.description: Common and usually uneventful — amphetamine releases little serotonin. The main effect is a bit more jitter and a higher pulse. Worth noticing, not fearing.

waterHeat.headline: Sip to thirst
waterHeat.body: Stimulants blunt thirst without changing how much fluid you need — not much more than usual unless you're dancing or in the heat. Sip to thirst; don't force water. A dry mouth is low saliva, not dehydration.
